scripts.name: Volume Footprint: Measuring by Math & Geometry
scripts.author: ata_sabanci

defaults.tick_size: required explicit syminfo.mintick value; never inferred

geometric.data: Finite OHLCV and explicit symbol minimum tick. buy=volume*(close-low)/(high-low); sell=remaining volume; flat bar share=.5.
geometric.interpretation: Modeled geometric volume allocation; not observed aggressor-side transactions.

intrabar.data: Explicit caller-supplied TradingView/ta/14.requestUpAndDownVolume aggregates, aligned exactly to chart bar opens: up_volume>=0, down_volume<=0, timezone-aware observed_at. Paired NaNs+NaT represent no engine data. Explicit lower timeframe minutes must not exceed chart duration.
intrabar.availability: Each nonmissing aggregate must be observed at or after its chart bar open and no later than its chart bar close; reject late observations rather than backdate. No OHLCV fallback and no claim of complete provider coverage.
intrabar.interpretation: Source takes abs(down_volume), then applies the same geometric price-distribution bells to both side totals. Signed intrabar amounts do not supply native footprint price rows.
intrabar.request_emulation: No emulation of request.security, TradingView feed-history limits, tick-timeframe bid/ask classification, or gaps/merge behavior. Caller must supply the library outputs for the same symbol/feed/context.

native.required: Exact TradingView request.footprint object, official rows with up_price and buy/sell volume plus native imbalance flags and ticks_per_row. Not reconstructible from OHLCV or these signed aggregates.
native.behavior: Raises NotImplementedError; never substitutes geometric estimates.

scripts.port_scope: Default numerical metric scopes: table Gaussian lattice rows, off-frame mass, newest intersecting window up to5000 bars, window POC/value area/nearest diagonal imbalances, rolling chart density components and flat-price atoms, sampled chart POC/value area/nearest imbalances, one-tick integrated band volumes, balance tilt, source Simpson residual and overlap diagnostics. Optional immutable price/volume/density arrays.
scripts.input_contract: Finite repository OHLC and finite nonnegative Volume; unique increasing timezone-aware bar-open index; explicit fixed-minute duration and optional as_of reject incomplete/future bars. Original source min/max parameters enforced. Main calculation uses caller's fixed history origin.
scripts.availability_contract: Each output is a completed-prefix last-bar snapshot available at that bar close; final-window/chart drawings are never backfilled to earlier rows. Engine observation timestamps remain explicit. Intrabar missing outputs remain missing even when older window/profile data exists.
scripts.state_contract: Source chart_poc variable persists when no new span/control level can be computed; chart_poc_fresh=false identifies stale values while per-band values reset toNaN. Flat-price atom mass participates in overlap/total volume but not continuous density or one-tick chart band integrals. Dashboard rows and profile density samples use distinct source CDF implementations.
source_quirks_preserved: Chart POC is the first maximal sampled density, while dashboard POC requires strictly positive summed row volume. POC ties prefer the lowest price; value-area adjacent-volume ties expand upward.
When all profile bars are atoms at distinct prices, continuous density is zero, but source best=-1 selects the lowest sampled price as chart POC. Status atoms_without_density exposes this edge.

Overlap scanner cuts only strict sign changes across12 scan intervals. An exact-zero sampled crossing may be missed, so the source diagnostic can overstate normalized overlap; do not interpret this as an independently corrected probability estimate.

Simpson integration can produce small residuals or overlap above100 by numerical error; values are not silently clamped. Source9-decimal comparison semantics retained at decisions; external precision fixtures pending.
